prompt: How should we integrate structural thinking four questions into PDE decompositions so that ambiguities become actionable inquiry before entering the SOUTH planning phase?

primary.target: structural thinking four questions into PDE decompositions

secondary.target: explicit mapping of the four questions to PDE decomposition stages (intent, constraints, assumptions, ambiguity treatment)
standardized prompts / checklist items that turn ambiguous language into concrete inquiry tasks
PDE templates and decomposition forms to embed the checklist and gating checks
pre-SOUTH validation step that enforces converting ambiguities into actionable inquiry before planning
worked examples and anti-patterns demonstrating ambiguous → actionable transformations
run a pilot on live PDE decompositions and collect practitioner feedback

tools_required: optional PDE engine or script for pre-SOUTH validation
assumptions: A SOUTH planning phase exists and is a distinct gating phase in the PDE workflow
The 'structural thinking four questions' are a known, reusable set (but exact phrasing may need confirmation)
Current PDE decompositions sometimes leave ambiguities unconverted into inquiry tasks
The team can change templates/process docs and run a short pilot

updates: README or CONTRIBUTING notes describing the flow
communications: Create a PR with template + doc changes
Open an issue to track pilot feedback
Draft a short facilitator note for practitioners running the pilot

Run a short pilot, collect feedback, iterate, then merge changes
